# Concord writing templates

This complete reference set is installed by concord init. `concord new` uses the bundled templates, not this directory. These examples are not adopted contracts or test evidence.

A document's path is its identity and its single top-level heading is its name, so templates carry no frontmatter. Issue and Memory frontmatter holds source facts and forward relations, and only when they are non-empty.

Feature, Roadmap and Engineering require README only; choose the other pages when creating them. A Design is one Markdown page for an open choice. Edit concepts.md and writing.md directly; they are not --pages options.

| Optional page | Use when |
| --- | --- |
| library | 公开编程接口、输入输出类型和调用示例 |
| cli | 公开命令、参数、输出和错误反馈 |
| api | 公开网络协议的请求、响应、错误与兼容规则 |
| format | 使用者编辑或读取的文件路径、语法、字段与校验 |
| ui | 布局、交互状态、键盘操作与可访问性要求 |
| performance | 场景、测量内容、性能预算与负载前提 |
| architecture | 实体关系、模块职责、数据流和不变量 |
| data-model | 内部实体、存储结构、约束、事务与数据生命周期 |
| use-case | 用户目标索引；具体路径通过 Use Case 创建 |
